messages.血炎でS2のコイン再使用とS3の破壊不能化を引き出し、火傷と破裂を重ねる斬撃アタ: A Slash attacker that uses Bloodflame [血炎] to enable S2 Coin reuse and Unbreakable Coins on S3, stacking Burn and Rupture. Suited to The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu teams that swap him out of standby with other Heishou Identities, since leaving standby or returning grants 3 Bloodflame [血炎].
messages.血炎: 最大3、ターン終了時に1減少。自分の基本スキルで敵へ付与する火傷・破裂威: **Bloodflame [血炎]**: Maximum 3, decreasing by 1 at Turn End. +1 to the Burn and Rupture Potency his basic skills inflict on enemies. He gains 3 Bloodflame next turn on using the Defense skill Rooster's Deathstrike [鷄窮則殺] and 1 Bloodflame on using S3 Bloodflame Massacre [血炎亂舞]. Through the passive Gamefowl, he also gains 3 Bloodflame on a turn he enters by stepping in from backup or returning.
messages.S2のコイン再使用: S2「酔いつ暴れまわってみせましょう。」はⅢコインの表面的: **S2's Coin reuse**: On Coin Ⅲ Heads Hit, S2 ... Fuel My Rampage. reuses that Coin if he has Bloodflame or is below 50% HP (once per skill). The same Heads Hit also adds Wrath damage equal to 10% of the final damage. It does not reuse on Tails.
messages.S3「血炎亂舞」: 4コインの広域乱射。戦闘開始時に血炎があるか体力が50%未満: **S3 — Bloodflame Massacre [血炎亂舞]**: A 4-Coin Unfocused Volley. If he has Bloodflame or is below 50% HP at Combat Start, all Coins become Unbreakable. +1% damage per 2% of HP lost by the target and himself, up to 50%. On Clash Lose, inflicts 2 Burn on the target and himself.
messages.火傷と破裂の合計: 各攻撃スキルは、対象の火傷と破裂の合計が6以上でコイン威力が: **Combined Burn and Rupture**: Each attack skill gains Coin Power if the target's combined Burn and Rupture is 6 or more.
messages.鴻園の君主ホンルとの連携: 「闘鶏」は「鴻園の君主」ホンルと尊命を発動したとき、: **Coordination with Hong Lu's The Lord of Hongyuan**: When Exalted Command triggers with Hong Lu's The Lord of Hongyuan, Gamefowl activates an effect that inflicts 1 Burn when skills inflict Rupture (3 times per turn). However, the data's wording does not settle whether this Identity or Hong Lu gains the effect. There is also an effect that keeps Burn damage from staggering him or reducing his HP below 1, but whether that line falls inside the Exalted Command condition is likewise unclear.
messages.破裂回数の消耗: 破裂人格としては破裂回数の消耗が激しい。: **Rupture Count consumption**: As a Rupture Identity, he consumes Rupture Count heavily.
messages.初動は守備(マッチ可能反撃)で次のターンの血炎3を確保し、S2の再使用とS3の破: Open with his Defense skill (a clashable counter) to secure 3 Bloodflame for the next turn, bringing out S2's reuse and S3's Unbreakable Coins. The 1 Bloodflame from S3 also meets the reuse condition for an S2 used later that turn. In Lord Hong Lu teams, swap him with other Heishou Identities to gain 3 Bloodflame each time he steps in from backup. Field him after other Identities have built Rupture Count, or use him in a Burn-leaning way where Count does not matter. His only ways to gain Burn himself are S3 and his Defense skill's Clash losses, so there is no need to force the self-damage-based bonuses of the combat passive Let's Get Battle-drunk (3 Wrath and 3 Gluttony Owned).
